original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Prove the exact positive-price tariff for two dirty output rows with demand (2,3) over Z/6, and the CRT extension to every demand pair over every Z/n, n >= 2.
scope_change_reason: Explicit donor assignment follows Open next question 1 of merged PR5045. This is an algebraic side result, not the card's original R439 H2/K replacement or a physical supplier claim.
bottleneck_link: Exact restored-row tariffs distinguish repeated source insertion from reversible mixing. A physical caller and its complete prices, framing/routing/precision/tape charges and supplier/outer admission remain missing; no new kappa follows.
stop_rule: Stop after one proved exact tariff with attaining words and bounded independent finite corroboration, or a precise counterexample. Do not expand into a physical construction without a complete caller bill.
evidence: README Theorems 1 and 2 and CRT lemma. Exact replay: 9,830 ordered CRT pairs; 24,575 candidate words; 147,450 forward/inverse basis checks; 2,160 literal Z/6 checks; 119 full-graph Dijkstra runs and 3,654 optimum comparisons; 16 controls. Universal claims rest on the written proof.
author: lee-phys, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, implementation, checking and writing. No independent human review or proof-kernel verification claimed.

open_questions.blocked_by: A general orbit criterion and the possibility that the demand ideal is not principal.
